newsitem.title: USA: US stocks seen flat to lower, techs seen pressured.
newsitem.headline: US stocks seen flat to lower, techs seen pressured.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were expected to open with a cautious tone on Tuesday ahead of the National Association of Purchasing Management (NAPM) index with tech stocks likely to face selling pressure at the open.

The Conference Board's index of leading economic indicators posted a 0.2 percent rise for August, in line with economists' forecasts. The report was not expected to significantly affect stocks at the open.
Traders cited an earnings warning from Xilinx Corp as prompting some pre-open selling in tech stocks, which have just lately recovered from a mid-summer sell-off.
